BiblicalUsage: Kenema means so, thus, after this manner. Ezra 4:8 says Rehum and Shimshai wrote a letter against Jerusalem in this sort, and Ezra 5:4 says they asked after this manner, what are the names of the men that make this building?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the enemies' letters are part of the record, and God kept the builders' names in it anyway.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
